description: Upload binary bytes via PUT /v1/blobs (raw body + Content-Type). Decode base64 from content_base64. For large files prefer direct HTTP multipart/raw PUT. Requires LITHTRIX_API_KEY. Subject to BLOB_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES and BLOB_STORAGE_LIMIT.

content_base64.description: Standard base64-encoded file bytes (no data: URL prefix)

content_type.description: MIME type sent as Content-Type (e.g. application/pdf)

filename.description: Optional display filename (sent as filename query on the request)

name: lithtrix_blob_upload
